name: Yamaha XSR700
engine: 689 cc liquid-cooled CP2 parallel twin, fuel injected
intro: The retro MT-07. Some 2018 bikes had a chain guard bolt recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2018 XSR700s are in recall 18V483 for chain guard bolts that can loosen.

recalls.what: Chain guard mounting bolts can loosen from vibration.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces both chain guard bolts free.
